summary: The prepared main checkout already includes upstream PR #33614, merged after v0.5.18, which synchronizes DSpark rank-local sampling and acceptance decisions before they can diverge TP sequence/KV state. A focused regression confirms that the prefill sample is synchronized before sequence-length publication. No new runtime fix was justified.

tests.what_was_measured: Five checks passed: rank-local DSpark target samples are overwritten by rank 0 on CPU and gfx950 tensors, TP=1 and disabled-site boundaries are no-ops, and the current prefill call site synchronizes before publishing sequence lengths.
Expected failing-before check against commit 71de97b264b04dcd514cf904003028aefe9775c8: its DSpark prefill source lacks self._tp_sync.sync(SpecTpSyncSite.DSPARK_TARGET, next_token_ids).
No whitespace errors in tracked changes.

gpu_execution.evidence: The CUDA-alike parameter of test_dspark_target_sync_overwrites_rank_local_prefill_sample passed with HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 on AMD Instinct MI355X, capability (9, 5), PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. This validates device-tensor overwrite behavior only, not multi-rank communication.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was available; the reported TP=8 collective sequence was not reproduced.
Kimi-K3 and DSpark weights were unavailable, so full-model execution and semantic accuracy were not tested.
The reported NVIDIA B300, CUDA 13.0, and NCCL 2.28.3 environment was unavailable.
The regression uses a deterministic fake TP group for the broadcast contract; it does not qualify NCCL transport or sustained concurrent serving.
The related upstream correction is strongly consistent with the reported failure chain, but production confirmation on the original workload is still required.
